items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: So we got this little band... And Leon Lewis was the drummer.

ctx.x: Yeah, in the spring. So we got this little band, it was Roy White and Jimmy Farris on trombone and I was playing alto. And Leon Lewis was the drummer. And we had Merle Williams again on piano. I have pictures of him. And a fellow named Charlie Odin on bass, playing tuba. MINOCWA

So we went up to Menocwa, Wisconsin to play for a dance marathon, you know, they had in those days. You played and then you took a rest but these people danced around the clock, you know. And while we were in Menocwa, Wisconsin, Leroy Rice from Milwaukee came through with his band. They had guys like Jimmy Dudley and all those guys with his group.
